newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse ended marginally lower Monday.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse ended marginally lower Monday.

text.p: The Ghana stock exchange ended marginally lower on Monday, data issued by the exchange show.
The GSE all-share index fell 0.09 point to 385.00.
As in most recent sessions, bids far outstripped offers but only 21,610 shares changed hands, down from 60,150 last Friday, which was itself a low figure.
Standard Chartered Bank rose 145 cedis to 5,200 and Unilever added 10 to 910, but the index was dragged down by a fall of 40 cedis in Ghana Commercial Bank to 580.
The Ghana bourse trades on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays.
